Maya: Quick heads-up — EBR prep for BlueWave on Tue 2026-03-30 10:00am PT. Exec + expansion ask. Need slide deck, one-page health summary, renewal risk table, and a 5-min exec talking points doc. Who can take which pieces?
Daniel: I can own the one-pager health summary. Where should I pull the latest product telemetry from? I think analytics dashboard access is limited.
Jess: I can build a 5-min demo of the prefix-caching improvements (helps p50 latency). Need ~10 mins with eng to capture benchmarks. @Daniel can you add sample session IDs we can replay?
Maya: Link to deck template: https://redwoodhq.slides/ebr-template (use "BlueWave - EBR" as filename). Please drop slides by Fri 2026-03-27 EOD. @Priya, FYI — need your exec talking points.
Priya: Will draft talking points. Quick note for the deck: usage MAU is down ~12% MoM, but embeddings usage is up ~40% — highlight that migration pattern. Also flag renewal risk score = 6/10 (timing + budget).
Evan: Sales context: renewal window starts mid-April. They're evaluating Dedicated for throughput. Recommend a cost/benefit slide + a pilot offer (30d dedicated trial). I'll bring contract timeline and current ARR.
Daniel: Added — pulled last 60 days telemetry and user journeys and dropped a CSV in #gs-bluewave. File: bluewave_usage_60d.csv.
calendar-bot: calendar-bot: Created event "BlueWave EBR" on Tue Mar 30 10:00-11:15 PT. Invitees: Maya, Priya, Evan, Jess, Daniel.
Jess: For the demo I'll need an anonymized query set and 2 synthetic long-context examples to show caching impact. @Maya can you confirm which flows to prioritize (search vs. chat)?
Maya: Confirmed — prioritize chat flows and the new customer onboarding demo. Action items (quick):
- Daniel: one-pager health summary (metrics + top 3 risks)
- Jess: demo + short recording clip (3-5 mins)
- Priya: 5-min exec talking points + renewal ask slide
- Evan: renewal timeline + pilot offer details
- Maya: consolidate slides, add blocker slide, run dry run Wed 2026-03-25 9:30am PT. :thumbsup:
Evan: Noted. Also suggest we surface cost delta per 1M tokens for Hosted vs Dedicated — customers always ask that. I'll provide numbers.
Priya: I'll include a 'next steps' slide with a clear CTA: pilot + exec intro. Also capture open asks from product: SSO config status and integration checklist.
Daniel: Quick check — is SSO fully set up on the customer side? I saw partial config flags in the ticket. If not, we'll mark it as a blocker and owner.
Maya: SSO = in progress, last update from IT was 2026-03-15. I'll add a blocker slide and owner: BlueWave IT (cc @Evan). Thanks everyone, please push slides to the shared folder and flag anything you need from product or eng before Wed dry run.
